_about: your-input (gate G3). Title family -> SOC codes an employer could plausibly file an LCA under. Families are matched in order; the first title_pattern that matches wins. 'record' means the O*NET alternate-title sample in data/bls/compact/soc_occupation_compact.csv lists that exact title under that occupation; 'your-input' means a human added it with the reason given. 'pruned' lists record-backed codes a human removed, with the reason. A family is used only when confirmed is true. The employer, not this file, picks the SOC that is filed.
